items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: Harry Watson was a leader... And we played for various entertainers

ctx.x: Do you remember who played that then? Did you?
They all did. Eddie Watson, Harry Watson, a fellow playing bass named Murray. And another Watson playing banjoes. Stringes. No horns.
Who got the band together? Can you remember a little bit over there?
